title: Hycroft Manor
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap way 328239442 supplies footprint and orientation. The eastward straight leg of the south elevation defines the authored X axis, and mapped driveway 947534827 locates the portico.
sectionBasis: The 1927 Leonard Frank photograph and City of Vancouver register description give the principal elevation, Ionic columns, dormers, second floor boxed sills, hipped green-tile roof, deep cornice and projecting chimneys.
limitations: Main mansion exterior only. Furniture, coach house and estate landscape features are outside this placement.
Heights, glazing, roof junctions, north elevation window spacing and concealed details are approximate.
